timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How do you even detect an insider threat? They have legitimate access.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: By analyzing behavior patterns. The risk score algorithm compares actions against baselines and detects anomalies.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What kind of behaviors trigger alerts?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Data theft, unauthorized sharing, bulk downloads, accessing unusual files, destructive actions on data.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: A dashboard that visualizes user activities across your environment. Helps investigators spot suspicious patterns.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: But what about employee privacy? Monitoring people feels creepy.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Privacy by design. User data is anonymized during investigation. Only authorized investigators see identities.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's adaptive protection? That sounds like sci-fi.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It uses ML to tailor DLP policies to individual risk levels. High-risk users get stricter controls automatically.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Right. A finance exec accessing financial data is normal. Same behavior from marketing? That raises flags.
